title: Speak Up: An Empowering Picture Book about Finding Your Voice and Making a Difference for
description: When something really matters, one voice can make a difference. This spirited, vibrant picture book celebrates diversity and encourages kids to speak up, unite with others, and take action when they see something that needs to be fixed. Join a diverse group of kids on a busy school day as they discover so many different ways to speak up and make their voices heard! From shouting out gratitude for a special treat to challenging a rule that isn’t fair, these young students show that simple, everyday actions can help people and make the world a better place. How can one small voice make a big difference? Finding Your Voice: Shows children that speaking up can be as simple as correcting a mispronounced name or as brave as challenging a rule that isn’t fair. An Anti-Bullying Message: A clear and gentle guide on how to be an ally when someone is being hurt, and how to ask for help from a grown-up when a secret is too scary to keep alone. Celebrating Diversity: Follow a vibrant and diverse group of students through their school day, creating a world where every child feels seen and knows they belong. title: Speak Up!: A Graphic Novel
description: For fans of Click and Brave , this touching coming-of-age middle grade graphic novel debut follows an autistic girl who finds friendship where she least expects it and learns to express her true self in a world where everyone defines her by her differences. Twelve-year-old Mia is just trying to navigate a world that doesn’t understand her true autistic self. While she wishes she could stand up to her bullies, she’s always been able to express her feelings through singing and songwriting, even more so with her best friend, Charlie, who is nonbinary, putting together the best beats for her. Together, they've taken the internet by storm; little do Mia’s classmates know that she’s the viral singer Elle-Q! But while the chance to perform live for a local talent show has Charlie excited, Mia isn’t so sure. She’ll have to decide whether she’ll let her worries about what other people think get in the way of not only her friendship with Charlie, but also showing everyone, including the bullies, who she is and what she has to say.  if(window.mix_csa){window.mix_csa('[cel_widget_id="tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1"]', '#CardInstance0qdZOR4OMsh2Uts6RcF2pA')('mark', 'bb')} if(window.uet){window.uet('bb','tell-amazon-desktop_DetailPage_1',{wb: 1})} ._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_icon_core_report__Fs1ah{color:#0f1111;color:var(--aok-sfs-color-page-primary-normal-fg,#0f1111);display:inline-block;-webkit-filter:none;filter:none;-webkit-filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);filter:var(--aok-sfs-effect-mode-dark-color-silhouette-white,none);height:20px;margin-right:4px;width:20px}._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_modal_spinner__3bz5K,._tell-amazon-desktop_style_tell_amazon_popover_inner__3tPIV{padding:20px 24px 0;width:65vw}._tell-amazon-deskto

title: Speak Up: How to Use Your Voice to Inspire, Influence, and Earn
description: Build a career in public speaking with a message that stands the test of time In Speak Up, author Hayley Mulenda Record delivers an inspiring and exciting new discussion of how to offer a message that will outlive you. She explains how to speak with conviction and courage and in doing so, guarantees that the message carried by your words last forever. You’ll discover the importance of having internal conviction and an internal conversation, rooted in something you live by, stand by, and advocate for. You’ll also learn about great voices from our recent past, including Mother Teresa, Nelson Mandela, Rosa Parks, and Martin Luther King Jr., that found a way to express their values in ways that would outlast them. title: SPEAK UP! Tell your Story to Influence Others: A Guide to Storytelling with a Multicultura
description: Your expertise is undeniable — but does your personal brand story reflect it? Winner of the Bronze Award in Business & Money and Self-Help (ReaderReviews.com) and BookLife Prize Semi-Finalist (BookLife.com) If you've ever felt that traditional leadership communication advice doesn't quite fit your background or your audience, you're not wrong. Speak Up! is the guide that finally bridges personal brand storytelling with multicultural leadership communication — helping you build authentic thought leadership that is uniquely, powerfully yours. Award-winning multicultural marketing communications expert Susana G Baumann draws on decades of experience helping corporate leaders and entrepreneurs find their voice. Her approach is built on a simple but powerful belief: your most compelling story isn't just about your skills — it's rooted in who you are: your background, your heritage, your family values, your journey. Part One guides you through building an authentic personal brand by exploring the rich elements that make you unique — race, ethnicity, place of origin, family traditions, and cultural values — and shows you how to turn those into professional strengths rather than hide them. Part Two gives you a simple, repeatable storytelling framework to structure your message and influence any audience — whether you're presenting to executives, pitching investors, leading diverse teams, or finally silencing the imposter syndrome that holds you back at the podium. title: How to Speak Up and Get Heard: Overcome Inner Hesitation, Speak Boldly, Handle Conflict Sm
description: Do you often stay silent even when you have something important to say? If you’ve ever walked away from a conversation thinking, “I should’ve said something…” , this book is for you. At home, at your workplace, with your neighbor, or in a restaurant. You feel hurt, offended, and unheard, and yet you keep silent, fearing a backlash. Guess what? You’re not alone. There are thousands of smart, capable people who face this daily battle of asserting themselves—not because they lack ideas, but because fear of being judged, rejected, or not knowing how to say it right holds them back . What if you could speak up without that palm-sweating, butterflies-in-the-stomach anxiety —and be taken seriously every time? In How to Speak Up and Get Heard , you’ll learn how to express your thoughts clearly, confidently, and calmly—even in high-pressure situations. Whether you’re stuck in meetings, avoiding difficult conversations, or constantly second-guessing yourself, this book will help you unlock your voice. Inside, you’ll discover: The Confidence-Communication Loop : why speaking up builds confidence—and not the other way around The Silent Saboteurs : fear of conflict, imposter syndrome, people-pleasing—and how to silence them Smart Scripts and Micro-Wins : tools to speak up in meetings, raise objections, and even say “no” gracefully The Tone Toolkit : how to say what you mean—without sounding rude, passive, or fake High-Stakes Speaking : what to do when it’s a make-or-break moment You’ll also find: Real-life examples Daily reflection prompts A free downloadable 7-Day Speak-Up Challenge workbook to turn knowledge into action Even if you’ve been the “quiet one” for years—this book will help you find your voice. title: Speak Up, Santiago!: (A Hillside Valley Graphic Novel)
publisher: Random House Books for Young Readers
description: Welcome to Hillside Valley! 12 year-old New York city kid Santi is heading upstate, in the debut of this irresistible contemporary graphic novel series about friends, family, community and identity—just right for fans of Mexikid and the Click series! Named one of the Best Books of the Year by the New York Public Library • An ALA Best Graphic Novel for Children • Winner of the International Latino Book Awards for Graphic Novels (Silver Medal) • Texas Bluebonnet Nominee • Texas Little Maverick Graphic Novel Reading List How can you speak up if you don't have the words? Santi is excited to spend the summer in Hillside Valley, meeting the local kids, eating his Abuela's delicious food, exploring! There's just one problem—Santi doesn't speak Spanish that well and it feels like everyone he meets in Hillside does. There's Sol (she's a soccer player who really loves books), Willie, (the artist), Alejandro (Santi's unofficial tour guide!), and Nico (Alejandro's brother and blue belt in karate). In between all of their adventures in Hillside, Santi can't help but worry about his Spanish-what if he can't keep up?! Does that mean he's not Colombian enough? Will Santi find his confidence and his voice? Or will his worries cost him his new friendships...and the chance to play in Hillside's summer soccer tournament?! Book 1 in the Hillside Valley Graphic Novel series introduces an unforgettable group of kids readers will love—look for more Hillside Valley graphic novels, coming soon! “A fun graphic novel about learning to understand each other.”—Kayla Miller, creator of the Click Series “I’ll say it in both Spanish and English! description: Written by professors with 40+ combined years’ experience teaching the course and a competitive background in debate, Speak Up! connects with students through lively writing, compelling real-life examples, practical guidance, and hundreds of custom-drawn illustrations that bring public speaking concepts to life. Instructors will appreciate the book’s serious coverage of concepts and theories, fascinating examples, and unique and often humorous illustrations that help students understand and retain concepts from the text. title: Speak Up— The Communication Code That Gets You Heard: Master Workplace Communication Skill
description: Finally Be Heard: The Proven Communication Code to Master Workplace Influence You know precisely what you want to say. But somehow, by the time you finish, nobody's quite sure what you meant. The brilliant idea you prepared? Lost in translation. The solution that could save time and money? Never voiced with confidence. The insight that could shift a meeting? Stuck behind hesitation. In workplaces everywhere, talented professionals go unheard—not because they lack expertise, but because they lack the communication skills that make others listen. Speak Up gives you a practical, three-part Communication Code you can apply immediately to build executive presence and career momentum. Inside this actionable guide, you will discover: Communication scripts for new managers to handle high-stakes situations with ease. How to handle difficult conversations at work without getting defensive, using real dialogue examples. Effective feedback techniques for supervisors to drive results and team clarity. Assertive communication strategies specifically designed for women in leadership . The "front-loading" formula to help you speak with confidence in meetings . Conflict resolution strategies for team leads to navigate office politics and pushback. Master the Three Pillars of The Code: 1. CLARITY – Focus Your Message Cut the linguistic clutter. Learn to front-load your point so listeners understand you immediately—even under pressure. 2. CONNECTION – Read the Room Master the silent signals. Know when to pause, pivot, or push forward so your workplace boundaries and messages land. 3.
